about: Labelled cases for the secretary's classifiers (tuning set). source: real-log = robocall or test-call speech from logs/ (numbers replaced with made-up ones), paraphrased-log = a customer call reworded so no real caller words are kept, existing-test = taken from tests/, rule = written from a documented rule (callscoot.toml, agent/sms/robocalls prompts, README). label true = the classifier should fire. confident false = owner to confirm; such cases are reported, never scored.
